summary: Frontend-only testing of ChannelAttributesEditor integration in Master Products New Product modal and Product Detail Attributes tab. All requested features verified working: 6 tab schema editor, category-driven schema morphing (Footwear default -> Wearables), required-completion counters, live char counter on Amazon bullet, custom-attribute add/remove/persistence across tab switches, product save with toast reporting filled channel attributes, and preserved channel_attributes + custom_attributes rendered on Product Detail Attributes tab.
critical_code_review_comments: Toast text 'X channel attributes filled' counts every key in channel_attributes even if the value is empty string / undefined. If a user opens a tab and types then clears, the empty key still contributes. Minor accuracy issue; consider filtering by truthy value in NewProductModal.jsx save().

custom_attributes added via inline form are stored keyed by section (tab name). If two categories share a section and user switches category mid-modal, custom fields remain attached to the previous section; acceptable per spec (session-only) but not documented.

Category dropdown includes 'Footwear', 'Electronics', 'Home & Kitchen' which are not in CHANNEL_SCHEMAS and correctly fall back to DEFAULT_SCHEMA; consider surfacing a subtle 'generic schema' hint in the editor header (currently shows 'Generic Product' label — actually adequate).
seed_data_creation: Created two in-session products: 'TEST Wear Watch' (SKU TEST-W-001) and 'TEST Persist Watch' (SKU TEST-P-002). Client-side only; wiped on reload.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All schema editor flows validated on live preview URL. Verified: modal opens with editor, 6 tabs present with counters, Footwear falls back to DEFAULT_SCHEMA (Flipkart model_number required, Shopify vendor required, Woo regular_price required), Amazon has gtin/bullet_1/description required with live 11/500 char counter, category switch to Wearables morphs Flipkart tab to include model_number, form, strap_type, dial_shape, notifications, sim_supported. Custom attribute add-remove works; persists across tab navigation within modal; also persists to Product Detail Attributes tab after save. No console errors seen.
